title: MCP: add scene_duplicate tool + doc.swap JSFL method
description:
Two additions:

1. Add scene_duplicate MCP tool to packages/vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts:
   - Add SceneDuplicateParamsSchema to packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts (look at SceneAddParamsSchema as model, probably just {})
   - Register handler in the MCP plugin: call duplicateScene(doc, state.currentSceneIndex) from @flash/core
   - Follow pattern of scene_add/scene_rename handlers

2. Add doc.swap(libraryItemName: string): void to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:
   - Finds first selected SymbolInstance in the current frame
   - Looks up the library item by name to get its symbolId
   - Updates the selected instance's symbolId to the new library item
   - Add to JsflDocument interface + makeDocumentProxy
